# PDFium notices

Native packages: bblanchon.PDFium.Win32, bblanchon.PDFium.macOS and bblanchon.PDFium.Linux, pinned to 158.0.8125 (non-V8 builds).

The accompanying LICENSE and licenses directory are copied verbatim from the upstream chromium/8125 distribution:
https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/releases/download/chromium%2F8125/pdfium-win-x64.tgz

Package/build sources: https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries
PDFium sources/API: https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/

Keep the notices with redistributed binaries. Review native library updates and platform validation together when upgrading this pinned version.

The NuGet package metadata additionally declares Apache-2.0; its text is included as Apache-2.0.txt from https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt. The upstream distribution notices above are retained without alteration.
